# ============================================================
# SITE IDENTITY
# ============================================================

> BAF Shaheen College Dhaka Business Club (BAFSDBC) is a student-run
> initiative club at BAF Shaheen College Dhaka, Bangladesh, established in
> 2015. BAFSDBC develops future business leaders through leadership programs,
> entrepreneurship training, workshops, business competitions, and professional
> development activities.

# ============================================================
# ORGANIZATION FACTS
# ============================================================

- Full Name: BAF Shaheen College Dhaka Business Club
- Short Name / Abbreviation: BAFSDBC
- Also Known As: BAFSD Business Club, BAF Shaheen Dhaka Business Club
- Founded: 2015
- Type: Student Initiative Club / Non-profit student organization
- Parent Institution: BAF Shaheen College Dhaka
- Address: 3rd Gate, Near Shaheed Jahangir Gate, Dhaka 1206, Bangladesh
- Email: businessclub.bafsd@gmail.com
- Official Website: https://bafsdbc.vercel.app/
- Target Audience: Students, partnership clubs, universities, Bangladesh
- Languages: English, Bengali
- Service Area: Dhaka, Chittagong, Bangladesh

# ============================================================
# MISSION & PURPOSE
# ============================================================

BAFSDBC bridges the gap between academic theory and real-world business
applications. The club fosters innovation, critical thinking, and leadership
to prepare members for professional careers and to contribute meaningfully
to the global business community. The club organizes workshops, seminars,
business competitions, leadership camps, and inter-college events.
